summary.zh: 先给几名队员安排动作，再一口气处理互相照应的守卫。
summary.en: Queue several characters, then act together against guards watching one another.

rules.zh: 玩家为多个角色预先指定目标与动作，再用一次确认触发。同步解决相互照看的敌人，避免一人倒下时另一人报警；不同动作的行走与出手时间仍需计算。
rules.en: Assign targets and actions to several characters before one release command. Resolve mutually watching guards together before one can raise an alarm; approach and execution times still matter.

decisions.zh: 全员立即出手，还是让远处队员先接近再触发？
decisions.en: Release everyone now, or let the distant character get closer first?

decisions.zh: 安排第三人解决新巡逻，还是留他处理计划失误？
decisions.en: Assign the third character to another patrol, or reserve them for a failed plan?

effect.zh: 动作完成时间差越大，玩家越需要提前站位或设置延迟。
effect.en: Larger duration differences increase the value of positioning and staggered starts.

effect.zh: 暂停降低操作负担；不暂停则保留观察巡逻和快速安排的压力。
effect.en: Pausing reduces execution pressure; live queuing retains patrol-reading and speed demands.

implementation.zh: Showdown 可预排多人动作一起执行；默认会暂停，Desperado 难度不暂停。
implementation.en: Showdown queues actions for coordinated release; it pauses by default, but not on Desperado difficulty.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：峡谷、水车和楼梯构成多条接近路线；图中没有显示诱饵、绳索或藏尸操作。
observation.en: System reference: the canyon, watermill and stairs create approach routes; lure, restraint and body-hiding actions are not shown.

cases.game: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun

implementation.zh: 可预先规划整支小队的动作并一起执行，用协同解决单人难以处理的局面。
implementation.en: Actions for the team can be planned in advance and executed together to resolve situations one character cannot handle alone.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：雪地街道上的绿色视野范围与多名守卫可见；没有显示伪装菜单或同步行动队列。
observation.en: System reference: green sight coverage and several guards are visible in a snowy street; disguise controls and synchronized orders are not shown.

contrast.zh: 两者都把多人动作压缩成一次触发；《赏金奇兵3》还把规划时是否暂停作为难度选项。
contrast.en: Both compress squad execution into one release; Desperados III also makes planning-time pause a difficulty choice.

combination.zh: 设计提案：潜入厨房时，一人递出餐盘引开视线，另一人同时换走文件；动作成功依赖交接时点。
combination.en: Design proposal: during a kitchen infiltration, one character hands over a tray as another swaps a document; success depends on the handoff timing.

setup.zh: 两名守卫相互看着，两个队员已分别躲在他们身后。
setup.en: Two guards watch one another; each has an agent hidden behind them.

action.zh: 你分别指定击晕目标，再按下同时执行。
action.en: Queue one knockout per agent and release both.

result.zh: 两人同时倒下，没有留下看见同伴遇袭的目击者。
result.en: Both guards fall before either can react to the other’s takedown.

next.zh: 接着分配谁藏身体、谁观察下一班巡逻。
next.en: Assign one agent to bodies and another to watch the next patrol.

firstStep.zh: 先做两名队员、两个固定守卫、每人一个可排队动作，再加共同执行按钮。
firstStep.en: Start with two agents, two stationary guards, one queued action each and a shared release button.

pitfall.zh: 不要一开始做长指令链；优先解释“尚未就位”和“已准备执行”的区别。
pitfall.en: Avoid long command chains initially; distinguish moving into place from being ready to execute.

test.zh: 玩家能否说清失败是站位、动作耗时还是触发时机造成，而非觉得队员不听指挥？
test.en: Can players explain failure in terms of position, action duration or release timing rather than unresponsive agents?
